description:
DNS cache has no max-size cap unlike RateLimiterStore/CircuitBreakerStore.

Risk: Burst of unique domains in 60s window (before cleanup cycle) causes unbounded memory growth.

Fix: Add max_entries cap to @@dns_cache with eviction in cache_dns(), mirroring RateLimiterStore pattern.
title: CrestHttpClient DNS cache unbounded growth between cleanup cycles
